pokedexEntries.dp: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

pokedexEntries.pt: The long tongue is always soggy with slobber. The saliva contains a solvent that causes numbness.

pokedexEntries.hg: Its saliva can decompose anything. It wraps its long tongue around things to coat them with its sticky saliva.

pokedexEntries.ss: It has space in its throat to store saliva. It can also roll up its tongue and store it in the same spot.

pokedexEntries.bw: The long tongue is always soggy with slobber. The saliva contains a solvent that causes numbness.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Their saliva contains lots of components that can dissolve anything. The numbness caused by their lick does not dissipate.

pokedexEntries.as: Their saliva contains lots of components that can dissolve anything. The numbness caused by their lick does not dissipate.

pokedexEntries.us: A contest is under way to determine which one can stick its tongue out the farthest. The current record is...more than 82 feet.

pokedexEntries.um: It uses its tongue much more skillfully than its hands or its feet. It can deftly pick up a single small bean with its tongue.

pokedexEntries.sw: Lickilicky’s strange tongue can stretch to many times the length of its body. No one has figured out how Lickilicky’s tongue can stretch so far.

pokedexEntries.sh: Lickilicky can do just about anything with its tongue, which is as dexterous as the human hand. In contrast, Lickilicky’s use of its fingers is clumsy.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

pokedexEntries.la: Its tongue can extend and contract freely, and it is capable of reaching lengths over 10 times Lickilicky’s height. Beware of the saliva, as it contains corrosive elements.
